archetype: 2 (Performance Pro) - Adapted for Tactical Football Scouting

headings.usage: Section titles, Axis labels, and major numerical callouts.

layout.section_container: relative w-full max-w-none px-6 py-24 md:py-32 overflow-hidden bg-[#0A0F0D] my-16 rounded-3xl shadow-2xl
layout.grid_structure: grid grid-cols-1 lg:grid-cols-12 gap-12 lg:gap-8 items-center max-w-7xl mx-auto relative z-10
layout.right_radar: lg:col-span-8 relative aspect-square w-full max-w-2xl mx-auto

motion_and_interactions.radar_entrance: Framer Motion: `staggerChildren` to draw the axes first, then fade in the reference rings, then animate the player shape.
motion_and_interactions.shape_draw_in: Animate the player's polygon path using Framer Motion `initial={{ pathLength: 0, fillOpacity: 0 }} animate={{ pathLength: 1, fillOpacity: 0.25 }}` with an `easeOut` duration of 1.5s.
motion_and_interactions.rings_shimmer: Apply a subtle infinite pulse to the 'Elite' and 'Pro' reference rings: `animate={{ opacity: [0.4, 0.8, 0.4] }} transition={{ duration: 4, repeat: Infinity }}`.
motion_and_interactions.hover_states: Hovering over a score callout or axis label scales the label up (`scale: 1.1`), brightens the #CCFF00 stroke, and highlights the specific vertex point.

component_instructions.radar_implementation: REPLACE Recharts. Build a custom 4-axis SVG radar using `framer-motion`. A 4-axis radar is mathematically simple (a diamond). This is MANDATORY to achieve the requested cinematic path drawing and precise score positioning.
component_instructions.score_callouts: Anchor the 4 scores (Technical, Tactical, Physical, Mental) directly at the poles of the SVG (Top, Right, Bottom, Left) using absolute positioning. Do NOT put them in a separate grid. Format them as bold tactical badges.
component_instructions.legend_and_tiers: Design a 'Tactical Key' floating panel (backdrop-blur) in the bottom corner. Do not use standard colored squares. Use dashed line segments that match the SVG strokes for Standard (4), Strong (6), Pro (8), Elite (9.5).

background_image.description: Cinematic night football stadium with floodlights. Used as absolute background for the radar section, heavily overlaid with #0A0F0D (Ink) at 85% opacity to make it a moody, dramatic centerpiece.

tactical_texture.description: Tactics board green. Can be used with mix-blend-overlay at 5-10% opacity over the right-side radar container to give it a 'chalkboard' feel.

instructions_to_main_agent: In /app/frontend/src/pages/ReportPage.jsx, locate the performance radar block inside the unlocked content (around line 2673).
Discard the Recharts `<RadarChart>` implementation. It is too rigid for the required cinematic feel.
Break the container out of the standard card `bg-surface`. Make it a massive dark centerpiece: `bg-ink text-[#F5F1E8] my-16 rounded-3xl overflow-hidden relative`.
Implement the stadium background image as an absolute positioned layer with object-cover and a heavy dark overlay (`bg-ink/85`).
Create a grid layout: Left side contains the section title 'Performance Radar' (Barlow, text-6xl, text-white) and the 'Tactical Key' legend. Right side contains the custom SVG radar.
Build the custom SVG radar with Framer Motion. 4 axes = simple coordinate math (e.g., center is 50%,50%, top is 50%,0%, right is 100%,50%, etc). Scale the 0-10 data to these coordinates.
Draw the 4 reference rings (Standard 4, Strong 6, Pro 8, Elite 9.5) as dashed SVG paths behind the main shape. Add subtle pulse animation to the Elite ring.
Draw the player's shape with `stroke='#CCFF00' fill='#CCFF00'` and animate it in using `pathLength: 1`.
Place the 4 axis labels and scores absolutely at the ends of the axes, utilizing `text-volt` (#CCFF00) for the scores.
Add hover interactions to the axis labels to highlight the corresponding point on the radar.
Ensure all new interactive or key elements have `data-testid` attributes.
